```{=html}
<div class="quiz-timer" role="timer" aria-live="polite">
  <div class="quiz-timer-display">10:00</div>
  <div class="quiz-timer-controls">
    <button class="quiz-timer-start" type="button">Démarrer</button>
    <button class="quiz-timer-pause" type="button" disabled>Pause</button>
    <button class="quiz-timer-reset" type="button">Réinitialiser</button>
  </div>
</div>
```

<style>
.quiz-timer {
  position: absolute;
  top: 0;
  right: 0;
  width: 390px;
  text-align: center;
  padding: 0.28rem 0.45rem 0.35rem;
  border: 2px solid #123b5d;
  border-radius: 0.35rem;
  background: #fff;
  box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgb(0 0 0 / 12%);
  z-index: 10;
}

.quiz-timer-display {
  color: #123b5d;
  font-size: 2.6rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  line-height: 1;
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
}

.quiz-timer-controls {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 0.35rem;
  margin-top: 0.25rem;
}

.quiz-timer-controls button {
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0.22rem 0.45rem;
  border: 1px solid #123b5d;
  border-radius: 0.2rem;
  background: #fff;
  color: #123b5d;
  font-size: 0.8rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  line-height: 1.1;
  cursor: pointer;
}

.quiz-timer-controls button:disabled {
  cursor: default;
  opacity: 0.4;
}

.quiz-timer.warning {
  border-color: #c62828;
}

.quiz-timer.warning .quiz-timer-display {
  color: #c62828;
}
</style>

<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {
  const duration = 10 * 60 * 1000;
  document.querySelectorAll(".quiz-timer").forEach((timer, index) => {
    const storageKey = `psy1703-quiz-timer-v1:${window.location.pathname}:${index}`;
    const display = timer.querySelector(".quiz-timer-display");
    const startButton = timer.querySelector(".quiz-timer-start");
    const pauseButton = timer.querySelector(".quiz-timer-pause");
    const resetButton = timer.querySelector(".quiz-timer-reset");
    let state = { running: false, remaining: duration, end: null };

    try {
      const saved = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(storageKey));
      if (saved && typeof saved.remaining === "number") state = saved;
    } catch (_) {}

    function remainingNow() {
      return state.running && state.end
        ? Math.max(0, state.end - Date.now())
        : Math.max(0, state.remaining);
    }

    function save() {
      localStorage.setItem(storageKey, JSON.stringify(state));
    }

    function render() {
      const remaining = remainingNow();
      const totalSeconds = Math.ceil(remaining / 1000);
      const minutes = Math.floor(totalSeconds / 60);
      const seconds = totalSeconds % 60;
      display.textContent = `${String(minutes).padStart(2, "0")}:${String(seconds).padStart(2, "0")}`;
      timer.classList.toggle("warning", remaining <= 2 * 60 * 1000);
      startButton.disabled = state.running || remaining === 0;
      startButton.textContent = remaining < duration ? "Reprendre" : "Démarrer";
      pauseButton.disabled = !state.running;

      if (state.running && remaining === 0) {
        state = { running: false, remaining: 0, end: null };
        save();
      }
    }

    startButton.addEventListener("click", () => {
      const remaining = remainingNow();
      state = { running: true, remaining, end: Date.now() + remaining };
      save();
      render();
    });

    pauseButton.addEventListener("click", () => {
      state = { running: false, remaining: remainingNow(), end: null };
      save();
      render();
    });

    resetButton.addEventListener("click", () => {
      state = { running: false, remaining: duration, end: null };
      save();
      render();
    });

    render();
    window.setInterval(render, 250);
  });
});
</script>
